name: resolve-bundle-host-computed
description: A descriptor with a hostname-only `bundleHost` (no scheme, no path) and no explicit `bundleUrl`. The resolver MUST compute both the bundle and style URLs as `https://<bundleHost>/bundles/public/<package>/<version>/<file>` — the PUBLIC prefix of `@ggui-ai/registry-core`'s visibility-split `BundleStorage` layout (H1). bundleHost-tier composition is anonymous render-time fetching, which only the public prefix serves; private artifacts reach the iframe via an explicit presigned `bundleUrl`, never via host composition. Keeping the shapes aligned means a bundle published to one registry resolves cleanly from the other.
